Since 2026-10-06 (ops/approvals.yaml id 23; 规划/11 §1.1 例外「改由 Codex 实现的任务」, §2.5, §7.3 row 14) the exception is granted per split task, not per 规划/05 row: an entry with a lowercase suffix (B1-14a) lets that one task through; an entry without one (B3-02) is a row the exception covers whole, with all its split tasks. Rows only partly in the exception (B1-14, QA-05, QA-09; B3-07 without its A/B/C judgement) are listed task by task. Since 2026-10-16 (ops/approvals.yaml id 30; 规划/11 §1.1「2026-10-16 起：未开工的任务默认由 Codex 实现」, §7.3 row 15; planning couli#114 and #115) a task not yet started defaults to a Codex implementation: started means rule tests or an implementation committed (a spec_commit, a test(spec) commit or an implementation commit; a claim or a brief alone does not count), and started tasks keep their split. Each such task is added to tasks one by one under the id of its ledger, never as a whole row (a row would also let through its split tasks already started); the approval field stays 23 for the rows of 2026-10-06, and an entry outside those rows rests on id 30. A listed ledger may name impl: codex with tester: claude: a Claude subagent writes the rule tests first (red), a fresh Codex read-only session reviews them, Codex implements through codex-run.sh impl --phase impl, and a fresh Claude subagent reviews the code (id 27: the family other than the implementer). Funds, attribution, payout, order back-fill, database recovery and failover, release-pipeline wiring, migrations and contracts stay with id 19 whatever the date: forbidden_paths below are unchanged and task.ts check refuses a listed ledger whose paths reach them. The native apps also move their new tasks to Codex under id 30, but those repositories are not gated by this list (the orchestrator runs their builds and simulator checks outside the sandbox). Read from the trusted root. Protected path, class 3: a change needs the owner approval label (owner-approved-<first 12 hex of the head>), which the orchestrator adds after checking the head commit (ops/approvals.yaml id 24).
